questions.subject: COMPUTING_PRINCIPLES
questions.learningObjective: Analyze how data retention applies in a computing setting.

stimulus.body: Data and Analysis: a case involving 4088 records. Consider how data retention governs the situation.

questions.stem: Which property of data retention matters for 4088 records?
questions.explanation: data retention: Data retention policies define how long data are kept and when they should be deleted to limit risk. With 4088 records in view, that principle distinguishes the correct choice; every other option rests on a specific misconception.
questions.hint: When should old records be deleted?
